en.headline: Four face District Court trial over alleged Man Sang pump-and-dump
en.dek: Prosecutors say a Telegram account calling itself Edan Master steered buyers into Man Sang Metal Packaging shares before a coordinated sell-off; all four defendants deny the charge.
body: Four people went on trial in the District Court on Tuesday accused of running a pump-and-dump scheme in shares of Man Sang Metal Packaging, now known as Hong Kong Entertainment International.

Yip Chi-fai, So Lung-ying, Lau Ka-wing and Chan Sin-ying deny one count of conspiring to use a scheme with intent to defraud or deceive in transactions involving the company's securities, contrary to the Securities and Futures Ordinance and the Crimes Ordinance. The prosecution says the alleged conduct ran from September 2020 to April 2021.

In opening remarks, prosecutors said a Telegram user styling himself Edan Master touted a "sure-win bull stock" and a "money printer", and that at least one investor who followed the tips later lost about 85 per cent of the money put in. They alleged that on 23 April 2021 a cluster of accounts sold tens of millions of shares in a short period, after the stock's turnover jumped sharply in the afternoon.
The case is among the first pump-and-dump prosecutions tried in the District Court. The four are on bail. The allegations have not been proven.

zh.headline: 萬成金屬包裝唱高散貨案開審 四人否認控罪
zh.dek: 控方指Telegram用戶「Edan師傅」誘使股民買入萬成股份，其後有組織帳戶同步拋售；四名被告否認意圖欺詐而串謀使用計劃罪。
body: 四人被控以「唱高散貨」手法操縱萬成金屬包裝（現稱港娛國際）股份，案件周二在區域法院開審。四名被告葉志輝、蘇龍影、劉家榮及陳倩螢否認一項意圖欺詐或欺騙而串謀使用計劃罪。
控罪指他們於2020年9月至2021年4月期間，在涉及該公司證券的交易中使用計劃，意圖欺詐或欺騙實際或潛在投資者。控方開案陳詞指，有Telegram用戶自稱「Edan師傅」，以「穩贏牛股」及「股市印鈔機」等字句招來，有投資者跟隨貼士買入後虧蝓約八成半本金。
控方又指，2021年4月23日下午該股成交急增，其後有一批被指互相協調的帳戶在短時間內泉出數千萬股。案件由證監會調查後提出檨控，屬較早一批在區域法院審理的唱高散貨案。四人獲准保釋，控罪仍有待法庭裁定。
